text: Does ClientCore automatically merge contacts when email and phone both match? I can't find an approved rule.
No automatic merge in current code. We flag possible duplicates for review, but I don't think that behavior is documented well enough to promise specifics.
Agreed. Please answer that automatic merging is not supported and avoid inventing matching rules. We need a separate product decision.
Understood. I'll say we do not have sufficient approved behavior for auto-merge.
Separate note: TalentFlow employer search is healthy again.
